name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require pickup afterward when the box falls. It can be satisfied by holding the box before the fall, since Response allows holding_box before or after box_fell. The task requires pickup again after each fall; use Response(holding_box? no) — this clause needs a template that enforces holding_box after box_fell, such as Response(box_fell, holding_box) only if the event semantics guarantee it cannot be satisfied beforehand.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box at the exit, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up again after every fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again afterward.
